name: Port the math, engine, input and world namespaces

comments.text: Part 2a: math (Vec3 and Vec2 value types with the glam operations, lantern:::angle), engine and input are in engine/src/host, registered through HostNamespace; tests/host/vectors-follow-glam-and-copy-like-values and the-engine-api-reaches-the-engine-state. Handles cross as i64 through a bit cast (BitsToScript), since i64(u64) saturates in Nox. World comes next.
